allow_large: The owner allowed it on 2026-09-28: each extra file is a one-line switch of CI and forge.toml to the new dev group
done_when: uv sync installs a declared dev dependency group with the test tools, uv run pytest runs the suite, CI installs the same group instead of adding tools at run time, and the README has a short Contributing section: clone, uv sync, uv run pytest, and fixes go through Forge

findings.body: The integration test invokes only `pytest --version`, and its temporary checkout contains no tests. It proves that pytest is installed, but cannot detect collection failures or failures when running the repository suite through the documented command. CI explicitly selects the dev group and invokes `python -m pytest`, so it does not supply this missing contributor-workflow proof. Extend the integration coverage to run the repository tests after plain `uv sync`, using `uv run pytest` with recursion prevented, and assert successful test execution.
findings.title: Not done: uv run pytest runs the suite in a freshly synced checkout

why: A developer who clones symphony-forge to fix a bug gets no test tools from uv sync and no instructions: CI adds pytest at run time and the README only covers using Forge
